capability_claim: A technical delivery spec classifies material domain foundation impact, links or blocks consequential technical decisions, and records minimum runway plus walking-skeleton proof before READY_FOR_PLANNING.

input.prompt: Create a technical delivery spec for approved screens whose Visual Contract marks FOUNDATION impact, but no technical component/token/state decision has been accepted.

invariants.criterion: Keep the foundation decision explicit and blocking; do not call the spec READY_FOR_PLANNING.

input.prompt: Create a technical delivery spec where approved API/data/security decisions establish shared prerequisites and one representative end-to-end walking skeleton.

invariants.criterion: Record per-domain impact, prerequisite decisions/nodes, blockers, dependent work and walking-skeleton proof in the delivery spec.

input.prompt: Create a spec for a contained feature using sufficient existing technical contracts.

invariants.criterion: Classify contained/none and avoid inventing foundation work for possible future reuse.
